end.summary:
- Discussed shared responsibility for keeping school clean, green, and safe.
- Identified separate wet and dry bins; wrappers go in the dry bin.
- Explained that wet waste can rot and become compost for the garden.
- Suggested a compost pit can be a dug hole near the garden and needs oxygen for microbes.
- Plastic in compost was stated as a mix-up and was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting waste, describing a compost pit, and explaining why everyone should help keep school clean. They used the idea that wet waste rots and can become compost, and identified oxygen as helpful for microbes. Anika mixed up plastic with compostable waste at the end, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet and dry waste and discuss which items can go into compost.
